The Hero XPulse 450 is finally here, and it looks like Hero is going all out with its new adventure motorcycle.
Making its first appearance at EICMA 2026, the XPulse 450 gets a 421cc liquid-cooled, single-cylinder engine producing 46.5 PS and 38 Nm, paired with a 6-speed gearbox. It also packs fully adjustable suspension, 21-inch front and 17-inch rear wheels, tubeless spoke rims, cruise control, riding modes and smartphone connectivity with Android Auto and Apple CarPlay.
